rawContent: She was murdered in 1981 when she had trouble with her tire on a road en route to work and pulled over to fix. Her body was never found until 19 months later in 1983. The guy who killed her was caught. Joyce (1945-1981) was rich in skills, a wife and a mother. #BlackLivesMatter
